summary: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq notification regarding the late filing of its 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F. The company had regained compliance with periodic filing rules earlier, but a subsequent delist determination was issued for non-compliance with the 2025 Annual Report. Sinovac requested a hearing to stay suspension and delisting. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance update regarding Nasdaq listing rules, not a special situation.
